# Paul Grice

*1913 – 1988 · British · [Analytic Philosophy](../movements/analytic-philosophy.md)*

British philosopher trained at Oxford who grounded meaning in the speaker's intention and distinguished what a sentence says from what it implies (conversational implicatures).
